title: Frontend: Login page with email/password and OAuth buttons
description: Build the login page. Similar to register but with existing account fields and link to forgot password.
acceptanceCriteria: Form has: email and password fields
Submit shows loading, handles errors inline
On success: stores auth, redirects to /dashboard

steps.details: src/pages/LoginPage.tsx. React Hook Form with email + password. On submit: POST /api/auth/login. On success: setAuth + navigate('/dashboard'). On error: show error message.
Add 'Forgot password?' link to /forgot-password. 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link to /register. Google and GitHub OAuth buttons.
Login with valid credentials — redirect to dashboard. Login with wrong password — see error. Click forgot password — navigate to correct page.
